subject: Ogre
picture: A huge clumsy ogre is jammed on a tight spiral dungeon stair. His shoulders press the center pillar and the outer wall. One giant foot hangs off a small step. He holds one simple log club in his right hand, a thick straight tree limb with a blunt end, almost as long as his torso. His left hand grips the smooth stair rail. One head, one torso, two arms, two hands, two legs, two feet. Hide wrap. Stone steps as large slabs, one center pillar, stone ceiling, closed wooden door at the bottom. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
